brief: Create invoice moved out of the Invoices-list dialog onto its own route, at the admin's request. Workbench: left column is a four-rung ledger (customer -> what they are paying for -> payment method -> paid date), each rung ticked once answered; right column is a sticky invoice sheet drawn from the draft (masthead, bill-to, amount-as-hero, line item, totals, rotated PAID stamp) with the Create button under it. On phones the sheet stacks below the rungs, so her read-then-create order holds at every width. Rejected a 5-screen wizard: she issues many invoices and a wizard hides the preview until the end. Server side, create now opens the customer account from a typed name and, given a payment method, issues the invoice paid and books its ledger row in the same call.

Gallery rows were ragged: auto-fit columns with the tile aspect ratio chosen by index (4/5 on every third, square otherwise), so each row was as tall as whichever ratio landed in it. Regridded to uniform square cells on a fixed 2/3/4-column dense grid, with the rhythm carried by one deliberate 2x2 feature tile (first photo, sm: and up only — on a two-column phone grid a 2x2 spans the full width and its rows have no single-unit sibling to size them). next/image sizes split for the feature vs the rest; Instagram card padding and mark step down at one square unit on phones. No new CSS.

brief: WhatsApp was the third item inside a closed speed dial — the gym's only booking path, two taps deep. Pulled out as its own always-visible control — an icon-only green disc, no label; the dial went quiet (paper + ink ring) and gained Instagram as its third action. Per the gym's call the WhatsApp control carries WhatsApp green (--color-whatsapp token). The glyph stays dark ink: with the label removed it is the only thing carrying the control's meaning, and white on this green is ~1.9:1 rather than the site accent, and the two triggers stack vertically with WhatsApp on the bottom rung, nearest the thumb. Also: accent Instagram tile closing the homepage gallery grid (handle derived from the CMS social row), and /llms.txt reading classes + prices live from the CMS.
